intro.text: A soldier of the Kholin army.
A highly decorated soldier of the Kholin army and one of Adolin's best.

items.text: Natem took part in the mission Shallan and Adolin led to arrest Ialai Sadeas. Once she was dead, Adolin had Natem and Gen go through her quarters, but Shallan took over and sent her Lightweavers to search them. Shallan then proposed reassigning Natem and the rest of Adolin's team for a time while she investigated Ialai's death.
